distilbart.summary: In modern natural language processing, text summarization stands as one of the most intellectually demanding benchmarks . The BART model marries bidirectional encoder representations with autoregressive decoding . BART achieves remarkable ROUGE metrics when fine-tuned on news corpora like CNN/DailyMail, though real-world deployments must account for token length limits, inductive brevity biases, and domain adaptation challenges . BART was proposed by Lewis et al. in 2019 .
